54000.meaning1: (medicine) which can be eaten between noon and dawn
54000.meaning2: something allowed to be taken by a Buddhist monk after noon and in the night
54000.commentary: (VINa) saddhiṃ anulomapānehi aṭṭhavidhaṃ pānaṃ yāva rattiyā pacchimayāmasaṅkhāto yāmo, tāva paribhuñjitabbato yāmo kālo assā'ti yāmakālikaṃ

examples.text: khādanīyaṃ nāma pañca bhojanāni, yāmakālikaṃ satt'āhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādanīyaṃ nāma.

54001.meaning2: stick contrivance for telling the time

54002.meaning1: name of a group of deities
54002.meaning2: name of a group of deities
54002.commentary: (THIa) dvīhi devalokehi visiṭṭhaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ yātā upayātā sampannā'ti yāmā.

examples.text: tāvatiṃsā ca yāmā ca, tusitā c'āpi devatā, nimmānaratino devā, ye devā vasavattino, tattha cittaṃ paṇīdhehi, yattha te vusitaṃ pure.

54003.meaning1: name of a group of deities
54003.commentary: (DNa) yāmunā dhataraṭṭhā cā'ti yamunavāsino ca dhataraṭṭhakule uppannā nāgā ca.

examples.text: yāmunā dhataraṭṭhā ca, āgū nāgā yasassino, erāvaṇo mahānāgo, so'p'āgā samitiṃ vanaṃ.

54004.grammar: pron, fem instr sg of ya
54004.meaning1: by whichever; by which; with which

examples.text: yāya devā manussā ca, sitā tiṭṭhanti atthikā, tarath'etaṃ visattikaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
yāya mātu bhato poso, imaṃ lokaṃ avekkhati, tam'pi pāṇadadiṃ santiṃ, hanti kuddho puthujjano.
dānañ'ca peyyavajjañ'ca, atthacariyā ca yā idha, samān'attatā ca dhammesu, tattha tattha yath'ārahaṃ, ete kho saṅgahā loke, rathass'āṇī'va yāyato.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu y'āyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā

54008.grammar: pron, fem loc sg of ya

examples.text: s'āhaṃ sugatassa sāvikā, magg'aṭṭh'aṅgikayānayāyinī, uddhaṭasallā anāsavā, suññ'āgāragatā ramām'ahaṃ.

54010.grammar: pron, fem loc pl of ya
54010.meaning1: in whom; in which; among whom; among whoever
54010.meaning2: in whom; in which; among whom; among whoever
54010.commentary: (ANa) yāsu kāsuci etāsū'ti etāsu khattiy'ādippabhedāsu yāsu kāsuci jātīsu.

examples.text: yāsu kāsuci etāsu, danto jāyati puṅgavo, dhorayho balasampanno, kalyāṇajavanikkamo, tam'eva bhāre yuñjanti, n'āssa vaṇṇaṃ parikkhare.

54011.meaning1: whichever of its; whatever of his

examples.text: evam'evaṃ khv'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, y'āssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā, yā ca khv'āssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā.
tatra y'āssa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa, yañ'ca khv'assa tatra sappi vā telaṃ vā taṃ uddhaṃ gāmi assa.

54012.meaning1: as long as… then; as far as… that much; until… to that extent

examples.text: yāva-assa kāyo ṭhassati tāva naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā na naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā'ti
so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.

54013.meaning1: as long as; as far as; so much so; up to; until; from… to
54013.meaning2: up to, as far as, so far that

examples.text: tāni yāva ca aggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni
abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya, abhabbo'va tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāva subhāsitam'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā

54015.meaning1: (of food) edible from dawnrise to midday
54015.commentary: (VINa) anāpatti yāvakālikan'ti-ādimhi vikālabhojanasikkhāpade niddiṭṭhaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ yāva majjh'antikasaṅkhāto kālo, tāva bhuñjitabbato yāvakālikaṃ.

examples.text: anāpatti yāvakālikaṃ yāvakāle nidahitvā bhuñjati, yāmakālikaṃ yāme nidahitvā bhuñjati, satt'āhakālikaṃ satt'āhaṃ nidahitvā bhuñjati, yāvajīvikaṃ sati paccaye paribhuñjati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

54016.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of yāvakāla

examples.text: anāpatti yāvakālikaṃ yāvakāle nidahitvā bhuñjati, yāmakālikaṃ yāme nidahitvā bhuñjati, satt'āhakālikaṃ satt'āhaṃ nidahitvā bhuñjati, yāvajīvikaṃ sati paccaye paribhuñjati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
yāvakīvañ'c'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañ'ca assādato ādīnavañ'ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ'ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ n'ābbhaññāsiṃ
yāvakīvañ'ca me, sāriputta, sakaṃ muttakarīsaṃ apariyādinnaṃ hoti, sakaṃ'y'eva sudaṃ muttakarīsaṃ āhāremi. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, mahāvikaṭabhojanasmiṃ hoti.

54018.meaning1: as long as; so far as; to the extent that

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū apaññattaṃ na paññāpessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattissanti

54020.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yāvajīva
54020.meaning1: for one's entire life; as long as one lives
54020.meaning2: for the length of one's life

examples.text: yāvajīvam'pi ce bālo, paṇḍitaṃ payirupāsati, na so dhammaṃ vijānāti, dabbī sūparasaṃ yathā.
jīvassa yattako paricchedo yāvajīvaṃ, cittam'adhikicca pavattanti te dhammā'ti adhicittaṃ, pabbatassa tiro tiropabbataṃ, sotassa pati pavattati nāvā iti patisotaṃ, pāsādassa anto antopāsādaṃ.

54021.meaning1: (medicine) which can be stored indefinitely; which can be kept for life
54021.meaning2: existing as long as one's life lasts
54021.commentary: (VINa) ṭhapetvā udakaṃ avasesaṃ sabbam'pi yāvajīvaṃ pariharitvā sati paccaye paribhuñjitabbato yāvajīvakan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: khādanīyaṃ nāma pañca bhojanāni, yāmakālikaṃ satt'āhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādanīyaṃ nāma.

54022.meaning1: and in this case; and in this regard; and as far as this; to such an extent

examples.text: yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, alam'eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ cittaṃ. yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, upamā'pi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṃ cittan'ti.

54023.meaning1: as much as; as long as; as big as; as far as
54023.meaning2: as much as, as many as, as far as

examples.text: ayañ'hi, deva, kumāro nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo yāvatakv'assa kāyo tāvatakv'assa byāmo, yāvatakv'assa byāmo, tāvatakv'assa kāyo
ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho therā bhikkhū yāvatako ahosi sabbeh'eva saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesuṃ.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako āyasmato sāriputtassa āyasmatā bhūmijena saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho therā bhikkhū yāvatako ahosi sabbeh'eva saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesuṃ.

54025.meaning1: as long as his; as much as his
54025.commentary: (DNa) ten'eva yāvatakv'assa kāyo'ti-ādi vuttaṃ. tattha yāvatako assā'ti yāvatakv'assa.

examples.text: nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, yāvatakv'assa kāyo tāvatakv'assa byāmo, yāvatakv'assa byāmo tāvatakv'assa kāyo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
ayañ'hi, deva, kumāro nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo yāvatakv'assa kāyo tāvatakv'assa byāmo, yāvatakv'assa byāmo, tāvatakv'assa kāyo

54026.meaning1: occurring after the third time; established after the third time
54026.commentary: (VINa) itare pana yathā tatiye catutthe ca divase hotī'ti jaro, tatiyako catutthako'ti ca vuccati, evaṃ yāvatatiye samanubhāsanakamme hontī'ti yāvatatiyakā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅgh'ādisesā dhammā nava paṭham'āpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā.

54027.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yāvatatiyaka
54027.meaning1: as much as thrice; as far as three times; as many as three times
54027.construction:
yāva + tatiya + ka + aṃ
yāvatatiyaka + aṃ
54027.commentary: (VIN) yāvatatiyakan'ti yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya āpajjati, na saha vatthu'jjhācārā.

examples.text: itiha bhagavā dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ imasmiṃ kathāvatthusmiṃ yāvatatiyakaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.
dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, na me byākāsi cakkhumā, yāvatatiyañ'ca dev'īsi, byākarotī'ti me sutaṃ.

54029.meaning1: if up to the third time

examples.text: yāvatatiyañ'ce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅgh'ādiseso.

54030.meaning1: as many as three times; after the third time; up to the third time

examples.text: yathā kho pana pacceka'puṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evam'evaṃ evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anusāvitaṃ hoti.
dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, na me byākāsi cakkhumā, yāvatatiyañ'ca dev'īsi, byākarotī'ti me sutaṃ.

54031.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of yāva
54031.meaning1: as long as; as far as; of all; to the extent that

examples.text: yāvatā kho, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo, akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam'akkhāyati. sā kho pan'ākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena, suññā dosena, suññā mohena.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho ahaññ'ev'eko jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītā'ti.

54032.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of yāva
54032.meaning1: because; according to which; due to which

examples.text: na tena paṇḍito hoti, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, khemī averī abhayo, paṇḍito'ti pavuccati.
cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, n'atthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvatā-ahaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan'ti

54033.meaning1: as far as the earth extends
54033.commentary: (ANa) yāvatā jagato gatī'ti yattakā lokanipphatti. (ITIa) yāvatā jagato gatī'ti yattakā sattasaṅkhārabhedassa lokassa pavatti, tattha sabbatthā'ti attho.

54034.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yāvatāyuka
54034.meaning1: as long as one's life lasts; as long as one's lifespan

examples.text: brahmakāyikānaṃ, bhikkhave, devānaṃ kappo āyuppamāṇaṃ. tattha puthujjano yāvat'āyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam'pi gacchati tiracchānayonim'pi gacchati pettivisayam'pi gacchati.

54036.commentary: (ANa) yāvatāvinītā'ti pamāṇavasena vinītā, pamāṇaṃ ñatvā vinītaparisā'ti attho. yāvatajjhā'ti pāḷiyā pana yāva ajjhāsayā'ti attho, ajjhāsayaṃ ñatvā vinītaparisā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: katamā tisso? ukkācitavinītā parisā, paṭipucchāvinītā parisā, yāvatāvinītā parisā, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso parisā'ti.

54037.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, from yāva
54037.commentary: (VINa) yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādetī'ti yattakāni ahāni jānanto paṭicchādeti, ahaṃ itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno'ti sabrahmacārīnaṃ n'āroceti.

examples.text: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvat'īhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.
tenah'ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī'ti.
uposatho, yāvatikā ca bhikkhū, kammappattā, sabhāg'āpattiyo ca, na vijjanti, vajjanīyā ca, puggalā tasmiṃ na honti, pattakallan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

54039.meaning1: for as long as one wants; as much as one desires

examples.text: yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu ime aṭṭha vimokkhe anulomam'pi samāpajjati, paṭilomam'pi samāpajjati, anulomapaṭilomam'pi samāpajjati, yatth'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvat'icchakaṃ samāpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.

54041.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yāvatīha
54041.meaning1: for however many days; for as many days
54041.commentary: (VINa) yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādetī'ti yattakāni ahāni jānanto paṭicchādeti, ahaṃ itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno'ti sabrahmacārīnaṃ n'āroceti.

examples.text: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvat'īhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.

54043.meaning1: as much as one needs; as much as one wants
54043.commentary: (VINa) yāva'd'attho'ti bhojanam'pi ettakan'ti aparicchinditvā yāva'd'attho paññatto hoti.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhuttāvī assaṃ pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāva'd'attho, siyā ca me piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍanīyadhammo
āvasathapiṇḍo nāma pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ sālāya vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā ajjhokāse vā anodissa yāva'd'attho paññatto hoti.

54044.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yāvadattha
54044.meaning1: as much as one likes; as much as is good for one
54044.meaning2: as much as one likes, as far as need be

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
gilānasamayo nāma na sakkoti ek'āsane nisinno yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñjituṃ, gilānasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.

54045.meaning1: as much as one wants; as much as one likes

54046.meaning1: as much as; only as much as; only as far as

examples.text: kā upanisā savanāyā'ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evam'assu vacanīyā, yāva'd'eva dvayatānaṃ dhammānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāyā'ti. kiñ'ca dvayataṃ vadetha?
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddaṃ vo, yāvant'ettha samāgatā, taṇhāya mūlaṃ khaṇatha, usīr'attho'va bīraṇaṃ, mā vo naḷaṃ'va soto'va, māro bhañji punappunaṃ.

54048.meaning1: as far as Brahma's realm; up to the world of the gods

examples.text: it'iha te āyasmanto tena khaṇena tena layena tena muhuttena yāvabrahmalokā viditā ahesuṃ.

54049.meaning1: how eloquently expressed; how well articulated (by)

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, abbhutaṃ, āvuso sāriputta! yāvasubhāsitaṃ c'idaṃ āyasmatā sāriputtena.

54050.meaning1: how well this was stated (by); how eloquent these words (of) are

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāvasubhāsitam'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā

bhavissanti, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ licchavī sukhumālā mudutalunahatthapādā te mudukāsu seyyāsu tūlabimbohanāsu yāvasūriy'uggamanā seyyaṃ kappissanti. tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto lacchati otāraṃ lacchati ārammaṇaṃ.

54052.meaning1: so much so; to such an extent; to such an extreme degree
54052.commentary: (MNa) yāvassu me, sāriputtā'ti, sāriputta, mayhaṃ udaracchavi yāva piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti. atha vā yāvassu me, sāriputta, bhāriyabhāriyā ahosi dukkarakārikā, mayhaṃ udaracchavi yāva piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā ahosī'ti evam'ettha sambandho veditabbo.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana… piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmī'ti udaracchaviṃ'y'eva pariggaṇhāmi, yāvassu me, aggivessana, udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

54053.meaning1: until I; as long as I

examples.text: so hi nāma, rājañña, coro manusso manussabhūtesu coraghātesu na labhissati, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti.

54054.meaning1: as far as the cremation ground
54054.meaning2: as far as the cremation ground

examples.text: āsandipañcamā purisā mataṃ ādāya gacchanti, yāv'āḷāhanā padāni paññāyanti. kāpotakāni aṭṭhīni bhavanti.

54055.meaning1: as much as one wants; as much as one likes
54055.commentary: (MNa) yāv'icchanti mukh'āyāmaṃ, yāva mukhaṃ pasāretuṃ icchanti, tāva pasāretvā bhāṇino, eko'pi saṅghagāravena mukhasaṅkocanaṃ na karotī'ti attho.

examples.text: parimuṭṭhā paṇḍit'ābhāsā, vācāgocarabhāṇino, yāv'icchanti mukh'āyāmaṃ, yena nītā na taṃ vidū.
yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.
accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.
iti y'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi

54059.grammar: pron, fem instr pl of ya

examples.text: imā kho citta, lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo, yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasan'ti.
yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.

54060.grammar: pron, fem abl pl of ya
54060.meaning1: from whichever; from which; apart from which

examples.text: yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.
y'āhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho, rañño aṅgassa paddhagū, sv'ājja dhammesu ukkaṭṭho, soṇo dukkhassa pāragū.

54062.meaning2: sacrificed, bestowed, given away alms or gifts

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.
sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko atthi mātā atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā

54064.meaning1: wanting to perform a sacrifice; wishing to make a sacrificial offering
54064.commentary: (APAa) āhutin'ti annapān'ādi-anekavidhaṃ pūjāsakkār'ūpakaraṇaṃ. yiṭṭhu'kāmo'ti yajitu'kāmo, dānaṃ dātu'kāmo ahaṃ.

examples.text: yaññe rato'haṃ bho gotama, yaññaṃ yiṭṭhu'kāmo n'āhaṃ pajānāmi, anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ, yattha hutaṃ ijjhate brūhi me taṃ.

54065.meaning1: performs a sacrifice; makes a sacrificial offering
54065.meaning2: to make an offering; to offer a sacrifice

examples.text: siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahāyaññaṃ yiṭṭhu'kāmassa koci'd'eva vippaṭisāro, mahā vata me bhogakkhandho vigacchissatī'ti, so bhotā raññā vippaṭisāro na karaṇīyo.
yaññe rato'haṃ bho gotama, yaññaṃ yiṭṭhu'kāmo n'āhaṃ pajānāmi, anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ, yattha hutaṃ ijjhate brūhi me taṃ.

54066.meaning1: from here; from this (person, place, or thing)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māṇava, āsanne ito naḷakāragāmo, na y'ito dūre naḷakāragāmo'ti?

54067.commentary: (SNa) na y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyethā'ti ayaṃ maggabrahmacariyavāso nāma na paññāyeyya.

examples.text: na y'idaṃ bhāsitamattena, ek'antasavanena vā, anukkamitave sakkā, yāyaṃ paṭipadā daḷhā, yāya dhīrā pamuccanti, jhāyino mārabandhanā.

54068.meaning1: (gram) technical term in kaccāyanabyākaraṇa for the primary derivatives ana, uṇa, ānana, aka, ānanaka

examples.text: yu ṇvu icc'etesaṃ paccayānaṃ ana aka icc'ete ādesā honti.
na kho mayaṃ passāma bhoto gotamassa yugaṃ vā naṅgalaṃ vā phālaṃ vā pācanaṃ vā balībadde vā, atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evam'āha
saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.
ye puggalā aṭṭha sataṃ pasatthā, cattāri etāni yugāni honti, te dakkhiṇeyyā sugatassa sāvakā, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā vatthakoṭisahassānaṃ ekaññ'eva taṃ vatthayugaṃ hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena paridahāmi, khomasukhumaṃ vā koseyyasukhumaṃ vā kambalasukhumaṃ vā kappāsikasukhumaṃ vā.
atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.

54072.commentary: (VINa) pitupitā pitāmaho, pitāmahassa yugaṃ pitāmahayugaṃ. yugan'ti āyuppamāṇaṃ vuccati.

examples.text: aññātikā nāma mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.

54075.meaning2: having the characteristic feature of competing

examples.text: ten'āha aham'ācariyapūjako'ti. ahaṃ ācariyānaṃ pūjako, na musilo viya yugaggāhī, mādisesu antevāsikesu ṭhitesu tādisassa ācariyassa kathaṃ parājayo, tasmā na taṃ jayissati sisso, añña'd'atthu sissaṃ musilaṃ ācariya tvam'eva jayissasi, so pana parājito vināsaṃ pāpuṇissatī'ti adhippāyo.
saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.
phālo ca pācanañ'ca phālapācanaṃ, yugañ'ca naṅgalañ'ca yuganaṅgalaṃ. evaṃ yogg'aṅg'atthe.

54079.meaning2: congruous, harmonious, connected to a yoke
54079.commentary: (ANa) yuganaddhaṃ bhāvetī'ti yuganaddhaṃ katvā bhāveti. tattha ten'eva cittena samāpattiṃ samāpajjitvā ten'eva saṅkhāre sammasituṃ na sakkā. ayaṃ pana yāvatā samāpattiyo samāpajjati, tāvatā saṅkhāre sammasati. yāvatā saṅkhāre sammasati, tāvatā samāpattiyo samāpajjati.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti. tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

54081.meaning2: congruous, harmonious, connected to a yoke
54081.commentary: (MNa) yuganandhā'ti ekakkhaṇikayuganandhā. etehi aññasmiṃ khaṇe samāpatti, aññasmiṃ vipassanā'ti. evaṃ nānākhaṇikā'pi honti, ariyamagge pana ekakkhaṇikā. (MNt) aññam'aññ'ānativattamānā yuganaddhā yuttā viya ariyamaggayuganaddhā aññam'aññaṃ paṭibaddhā'ti yuganaddhā. ten'āha, ekakkhaṇikayuganandhā'ti ariyamaggakkhaṇe eva hi samathavipassanā ekakkhaṇikā hutvā samadhuraṃ vattanti.

examples.text: tass'ime dve dhammā yuganandhā vattanti, samatho ca vipassanā ca. so ye dhammā abhiññā pariññeyyā te dhamme abhiññā parijānāti.

54082.meaning2: end of an age or generation

examples.text: atha kho pukkuso mallaputto taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato upanāmesi, idaṃ, bhante, siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti.

54085.meaning1: length of a yoke; short distance; (comm) four cubits
54085.commentary: (MNa) yugamattan'ti navavidatthimatte cakkhūni ṭhapetvā gacchanto yugamattaṃ pekkhati nāma, bhagavā'pi yuge yutto sudantāajānīyo viya ettakaṃ passanto gacchati. (VINa) yugamattaṃ pekkhamāno'ti yugayuttako hi danto ājāneyyo yugamattaṃ pekkhati, purato catuhatthappamāṇaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, iminā'pi ettakaṃ pekkhantena gantabbaṃ.

examples.text: apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyen'eva apaloketi, so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi, na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañ'ca pekkhati, tato c'assa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
okkhittacakkhunā antaraghare gantabbaṃ yugamattaṃ pekkhantena. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca tahaṃ tahaṃ olokento antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
sotañ'ca [sotañ'c'eva (?) evam'itarayugalesu'pi] saddā ca

eten'upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.

54091.meaning1: you have entered into an engagement with; you have entered the ring with; you have got tied with
54091.meaningLit: you have assembled the yoke with
54091.commentary: (SNPa) dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā'ti dhutakilesena buddhena saddhiṃ yugaggāhaṃ samāpanno. (NIDD1) dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti. pasūro paribbājako na paṭibalo dhonena buddhena bhagavatā saddhiṃ yugaṃ samāgamaṃ samāgantvā yugaggāhaṃ gaṇhitvā sākacchetuṃ sallapituṃ sākacchaṃ samāpajjituṃ.

examples.text: atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.

54092.meaning1: putting on the yoke; shouldering the yoke

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti yug'ādhāne.
mahāsamuddo pathavī, pabbato anilo'pi ca, upamāya na yujjanti, satthu varavimuttiyā.
sabbehi dhātūhi bhāvakammesu yapaccayo hoti. ṭhīyate, bujjhate, paccate, labbhate, karīyate, yujjate, uccate. bhāvakammesū'ti kim'atthaṃ? karoti, pacati, paṭhati.
muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.
divu'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato yapaccayo hoti kattari. dibbati, sibbati, yujjhati, vijjhati, bujjhati.
